2F.10 Whoever shall break one of the least of these commandments (of God), and so teaches others, shall be called least in the kingdom of God; but whoever keeps and teaches them, he shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
2F.13 The law and word of God is absolute and perpetual.
3F.8 Whosoever is angry with his brother without cause shall be in danger of judgment.
3I.2 We are to love our personal adversaries.
3I.3 Pray for and forgive those that hate and persecute you.
3I.18 Christians should submit to a petty assault or wrong rather than engage in strife and conflict (should turn the other cheek).
4D.14 We should avoid making any oaths so that you may not fall under judgment.
5D.1 To lie carnally with another man's wife is forbidden.
5D.5 Adultery not to be committed in the heart.
5D.8 Marriage of a divorced woman is adultery.
5F.4 Divorce of a wife permitted for her act of fornication.
10A.1 Thou shall not murder.
12A.6 Keep yourself pure in mind and heart.
12E.10 Libel and name calling is condemned by Christ.
15A.16 Give to him who asks of you, and do not turn away from him who wants to borrow from you.
16A.3 Those who need to borrow from you are not to be turned away.
17A.3 Anger without cause is condemned.
17H.5 Do not to lust after the beauty of women.
17I.4 Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
